comment: The permission module could not load (missing, syntax error, constructor throws, a required service is absent). There are no presets then, and the harness keeps its own default mode, which refuses the shell here. Nothing may run, and no question is asked.

scenarios.name: closed: a shell command is refused, nothing runs, nothing is asked

input.command: echo c > @WORK@/closed.txt; echo c > @WORK@/../closed-outside.txt; echo OUT-closed

results.match: no sandbox backend is usable|refusing to run the command unconfined|SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE
